top_signals.title: Bolivia Ups Diesel Costs for Big Buyers to Tame Supply Shock
top_signals.summary: Bolivia’s government raised diesel prices 84% for larger consumers of the key industrial fuel, following shortages that caused long lines at gas stations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: L3Harris ousts CEO Chris Kubasik over unspecified 'conduct,' stock drops 4%
top_signals.summary: Chris Kubasik was ousted as Lockheed Martin's incoming CEO in 2012 after what that company called "close personal relationship with a subordinate employee."

top_signals.title: OCC approves Trump family crypto company for trust charter
top_signals.summary: The US financial regulator gave conditional approval for World Liberty Financial’s charter bid as ten Democrats signed onto a bill to “prevent corruption in banking applications.“
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
